name: Equivalent query access paths must return the same allowed result set

payload.proof: prepared and unprepared execution, table and index access, and index-merge and non-index-merge paths must preserve the same SQL result semantics
payload.oracle: compare normalized allowed result sets and index closure across path controls

evidence.oracle: the compared access paths must return the same allowed result set and preserve index closure

lessons.result: shallow expansion of SQL shapes in plan-cache and index-path lanes has low marginal yield at this point
lessons.next_selector: move to collection-wide durable invariants whose proof or guard is scoped to one member or one publication stage

title: Last-region empty end key might bypass snapshot-ingest range latch

payload.candidate: RangeLatch compares byte ranges and would treat an empty end key as the smallest key rather than positive infinity
payload.rejection: production snapshot apply calls enc_end_key(region), and enc_end_key maps an empty Region end key to DATA_MAX_KEY before acquiring the latch
payload.action: do not reopen unless a different production caller passes an unnormalized empty end key

title: Per-CF snapshot ingest latch leaves a cross-CF observation gap

payload.candidate: snapshot apply ingests Default, Lock, and Write CF separately, while each ingest acquires and releases the range latch independently; the compaction filter can therefore run between CF ingestions
payload.rejection: a destructive witness still requires an older local Write record that contradicts the incoming snapshot Write history; ordinary peer removal and re-addition preserves Raft progress and timestamp lineage, so the current proof does not establish such a state through a supported lifecycle
payload.method_value: a lock-scope mismatch is only a candidate generator; promotion requires a legal producer for the mixed state and a fresh MVCC terminal oracle
payload.action: reopen only if a supported recovery, snapshot rollback, or region lifecycle can produce the contradictory Write lineage without physical-state injection
